results: Reapplying the migration preserves an already enabled Hotel mode and all custom settings
Hosted-style non-superuser migration rolls back safely and preserves data on apply and reapply
Mode is optional, tenant-scoped and Restaurant-only; older clients preserve its saved value
Hotel room commits as Hotel and Web without installing a guest
Hotel without an assigned room remains Hotel with a room to complete
Exterior and legacy clients remain Exterior and Web
Server rejects malformed guest declarations, room injection and external rooms
Disabled mode rejects a new Hotel submission even with a forged client or QR hint
Groups keep one-hour holds; Reception sees stay details but cannot approve
Pending profile changes preserve the original until approval, and rejection restores its profile
Approved reclassification clears the old room and preserves internal notes
Old clients cannot silently turn an existing Hotel booking into Exterior
Employee room correction and reclassification synchronize the guest link without exposing notes
Expiry of a proposed stay change restores the original Hotel profile
Disabling new Hotel entry preserves an existing Hotel management link and its cancellation
Legacy Hotel records without new contact fields retain their actual profile after mode is disabled
Public profile exposes no rooms or guests, and technical permissions stay restricted
